basic_details.job_title: NIT Kurukshetra Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 2 Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Posts
basic_details.short_information: The National Institute of Technology Kurukshetra, working with IIT Indore as the hub institution, has invited applications for 02 Junior Research Fellow (JRF) positions in the ANRF-sponsored project "SAKSHAM- Scientific Advancements in Knowledge for Sustainability, Healthcare, and Materials" under the ANRF PAIR Program. The positions are in the Department of VLSI Design and Systems Engineering and the Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering. The fellowship is Rs. 37,000 per month plus HRA (as per norms). The essential qualification is a post-graduation in Engineering/Technology

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice prints one eligibility rule for the JRF positions. A candidate must meet either of the two options below. Post-graduation in Engineering/Technology with 60% aggregate marks or an average CGPA of 6.5 on a 10-point scale for GEN. Marks are relaxed by 5%, or by a CGPA of 0.5 (10-point scale), for SC/ST/PwD candidates. The degree must be from a UGC recognized University/Institute/Autonomous body. Final-year Master's applicants who have submitted their dissertation/thesis but do not have final-semester results by the application deadline may apply. They must submit the results by 15 December 2026; otherwise any JRF offer made to them will be cancelled. OR a full-time Bachelor's Degree in Engineering/Technology or equivalent with a minimum of 75% marks in aggregate or 8.0 CGPA on a 10-point scale or equivalent. Desirable qualification: CSIR/UGC-NET or GATE qualification. The notice says the listed qualifications are minimum requirements and do not guarantee an invitation to the written test and/or interview. Age limit: upper age limit 32 years as on the last date of application. The notice prints no age relaxation. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each project, candidates should check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The fellowship is Rs. 37,000/- p.m. + HRA (as per norms). The initial appointment is up to 30 June 2027. It is to be continued till September 2029 or co-terminus with the duration of the project, based on the candidate's performance (semester wise). The selected candidate will be encouraged to join and complete a Ph.D. at NIT Kurukshetra as per the rules and regulations of NIT Kurukshetra.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIT Kurukshetra Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
content_sections.text: Open the application format linked in the notice (the prescribed format is available through the link in the "How to Apply" section). Fill in the application in that prescribed format. Scan all relevant educational certificates properly and combine them into a single PDF file. Submit the application with the certificates through the Google form linked in the notice. Give a valid e-mail ID in the application, because the written test and interview dates are sent by e-mail. Submit before 18 November 2026, 11:59 PM. Incomplete applications and applications received after the deadline will be rejected. For any query or difficulty, the notice asks candidates to e-mail [email protected] or [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of a written test and an interview in physical mode at NIT Kurukshetra. Only shortlisted candidates will be informed about the written examination and interview schedule via e-mail. The syllabus for the written examination in the respective disciplines is as per their GATE/NET curriculum. Candidates who have qualified GATE/NET or any other national level examination are exempted from the written examination. The notice does not print the dates of the written test or interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many JRF vacancies are there in NIT Kurukshetra Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 02 Junior Research Fellow (JRF) positions, one in each of the two projects listed in Advt. No. 36/2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Kurukshetra JRF positions?
faq.answer: The last date is 18 November 2026, 11:59 PM. Incomplete applications and applications received after the deadline will be rejected.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the NIT Kurukshetra JRF positions?
faq.answer: A post-graduation in Engineering/Technology with 60% aggregate marks or CGPA 6.5 for GEN (relaxed by 5% or CGPA 0.5 for SC/ST/PwD), or a full-time Bachelor's Degree in Engineering/Technology or equivalent with minimum 75% marks or 8.0 CGPA.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the NIT Kurukshetra JRF positions?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 32 years as on the last date of application.

faq.question: Q5. What is the fellowship for the NIT Kurukshetra JRF?
faq.answer: The fellowship is Rs. 37,000/- p.m. + HRA (as per norms).

faq.question: Q6. Are HRA and other allowances paid on top of the Rs. 37,000 fellowship?
faq.answer: HRA is mentioned as payable in addition, as per norms: the notice prints "Rs. 37,000/- p.m. + HRA (as per norms)". The notice names no other allowance.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the NIT Kurukshetra JRF positions?
faq.answer: Submit the application in the prescribed format, with all relevant educational certificates scanned in a single PDF file, through the Google form linked in the notice.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the NIT Kurukshetra JRF?
faq.answer: Selection consists of a written test and an interview in physical mode at NIT Kurukshetra. Candidates who have qualified GATE/NET or any other national level examination are exempted from the written examination.

faq.question: Q9. How long does the JRF appointment last?
faq.answer: The initial appointment is up to 30 June 2027. It is to be continued till September 2029 or co-terminus with the project, based on the candidate's performance (semester wise).

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the interview or written test?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview/written test.
